name: battery-display
title: Battery Display
summary: Test patch: shows a battery percentage.
description: Shows the battery as an icon, as a percentage, or as both. It can also use a curve from a larger battery in place of the Apple table.
details: During a charge, the iPod shows the charge icon and the percentage. With Display set to Icon, it shows only the charge icon.
The Apple data moves in steps of 5 %. The Apple icon has only 16 levels.
Custom Battery changes the battery picture and the percentage. It does not change when the iPod stops.
Battery Curve imports a battery log, so that you can make a curve for your own battery.
notes: The built-in Custom Battery curve is provisional. It comes from one larger battery and is not from a full charge. Import a log for your own battery.
The percentage reads high during a charge, because the charge raises the voltage.
Icon + Percent is not tested. Check the text and the title on each screen.

choices.title: Icon + Percent
choices.description: The battery icon, and the percentage at its left.
choices.caution: This is not tested. The text can touch a long title.

choices.title: Apple
choices.description: The Apple table. Use this for a battery of the original size.

choices.title: Custom Battery
choices.description: A curve from a larger battery. It changes the icon and the percentage.
choices.caution: The curve is provisional. It is for one battery, and other batteries are different.

choices.title: Off
choices.description: The percentage follows the data directly. Apple data moves in steps of 5 %.

choices.title: On
choices.description: A longer average, and no small rises. Apple data moves in steps of 1 %, but it is then not the exact Apple logic. The value changes more slowly, and it can stay still for some minutes.
